name: site-architecture
description: Plan site structure and information architecture for a website: a page tree where every page has exactly one parent, URL rules, navigation labels and breadcrumbs; an internal linking plan from a links export (source and target) that uses only your own URLs, with inlinks and click depth before and after; hub page and child page links; which filter URLs get indexable pages, with the URL count worked out; and a redirect map for site migrations and URL changes, checked for chains, loops and homepage targets. Not a search audit and not software architecture.
